info.description: Immutable ledger row. ONE row per qualifying deposit. `sourceTransaction` is UNIQUE (raw-SQL constraint in the migration) — that's what makes accrual idempotent under duplicate webhook + verify-callback firings. `ratePercent` is a snapshot at the time of accrual; later changes to the config rate never mutate existing rows.

sourceTransaction.description: The confirmed deposit that this commission was accrued against. Unique — enforced at the DB layer by an idempotency-guard migration.

walletTransaction.description: The affiliate_commission credit that lives on the affiliate's wallet. This is what shows up in their transaction history.

reversalTransaction.description: Only set once status='reversed'. Points at the affiliate_commission_reversal debit that was booked against the affiliate's wallet.

paymentGateway.description: Denormalised copy of the source deposit's gateway (stripe / paypal / razorpay / bank_transfer / phonepe). Duplicated here so ledger queries don't have to join.

ratePercent.description: Snapshot of the percentage rate applied at accrual time. Never recomputed if the admin later changes the global default.
